mapper.select: SELECT email, code_hash, expires_at, failed_attempts, last_sent_at, send_window_started_at, send_count, verified_at FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verifications (email, code_hash, expires_at, failed_attempts, last_sent_at, send_window_started_at, send_count, verified_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, 0, #{lastSentAt}, #{sendWindowStartedAt}, #{sendCount}, NULL) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE code_hash = VALUES(code_hash), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at), failed_attempts = 0, last_sent_at = VALUES(last_sent_at), send_window_started_at = VALUES(send_window_started_at), send_count = VALUES(send_count), verified_at = NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verifications SET failed_attempts = failed_attempts + 1 WHERE email = #{email}
UPDATE email_verifications SET verified_at = NOW() WHERE email = #{email}
